Shwe Pyi Hotel

Beside the moat, five minutes from the palace.

About the hotel

Shwe Pyi Hotel is a family-run, 24-room boutique property on Moat Road in Mandalay. The teak lobby, rooftop pool and open-air restaurant were rebuilt in 2019, and every room looks either onto the moat or into the courtyard garden.
